card.name: Word start before an -ing ending
card.fires_on: A short word-start piece (like st, imp, sh, Sy) where the next piece is an "ing" ending, as in stinging, impingement, shingles, syringe.

modes.label: st- before sting words
modes.description: The piece "st" just before "inging", "inger" or "ung", about stings or burning sensations.

modes.label: Other broken-up words with ing
modes.description: Other words split so that an "ing" piece comes next, such as impingement, shingles, syringe or Ingenuity.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with an "ing" ending piece.
card.plain: It fires on the start of a word when the next letters are "ing", like sting or syringe.
